summary.zh: 评估超权限折扣交易并给出审批路径
summary.en: Score off-policy deals and route them to the right approvers

description.zh: 对折扣超出销售权限、MSA 被改条款或单笔经济性不清的成交机会做评分，指明需要哪些层级审批，并标出高风险条款。只提供建议，不会自动批准。
description.en: Scores deals that need discounts beyond rep authority, carry redlined MSAs or have unclear unit economics, names the approvers required and flags risky terms. It never approves a deal automatically.
